Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full account-selector payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Which account can I help you with?","mode":"single","accounts":[{"id":"chk-1234","name":"Everyday Checking","type":"Checking","mask":"1234","balance":4820.55,"currency":"USD","badge":"Primary"},{"id":"sav-5678","name":"High-Yield Savings","type":"Savings","mask":"5678","balance":15230.00,"currency":"USD"},{"id":"crd-9012","name":"Rewards Card","type":"Credit Card","mask":"9012","balance":-742.18,"currency":"USD","available":9257.82}],"submitText":"Continue"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): the prompt shown above the list.
- 'mode' (string, required): 'single' or 'multiple'. Use 'single' when the customer should pick exactly one account (the card sends the choice immediately on click). Use 'multiple' when they may pick several (a submit button appears).
- 'accounts' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): each account MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back on selection), 'name' (string), 'type' (string; one of 'Checking','Savings','Credit Card','Loan','Investment' — drives the row icon), 'mask' (string, the last 4 digits of the account number), and 'balance' (number; may be negative for amounts owed). Optional per account: 'currency' (ISO code string, defaults to 'USD'), 'available' (number, e.g. available credit or balance after holds), 'badge' (short string tag such as 'Primary').
- 'submitText' (string, optional): button label used only in 'multiple' mode; defaults to 'Continue'.

Never emit an empty 'accounts' array. Use the customer's real accounts from context; if none are known, ask the customer rather than inventing account numbers. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
